For chart watchers: candlestick charts are built from fixed time blocks (e.g. a "5-minute candle"). This adds a small progress bar showing how far into the current block you are, so you know when the next candle will form without tabbing over to your charting app. If you don't watch candlestick charts, leave this Off.
Shows the exchange's session — pre-market, open, lunch break (Tokyo, Hong Kong, Singapore), after-hours, or closed — with a live countdown to the next change, color-coded by session. No API key required.
